title: Low-Carb Turkey Casserole

ingredients.raw: 1 pound Crimini mushrooms, washed and sliced
4 cups cooked leftover turkey or chicken
2 T olive oil, divided (more or less depending on your pan)
salt and fresh-ground black pepper to taste

instructions: Spray a large glass or crockery casserole dish with olive oil or non-stick spray. (10" x 13" or similar size.)
Preheat oven to 375F/190C.
Chop cauliflower to make 6 cups of small pieces, then pulse in food processor or grate with box grater to create cauliflower rice texture.
Alternatively, use frozen cauliflower rice (about 3 cups).
Wash mushrooms and cut into thick half slices.
Dice leftover turkey (or chicken) into bite-sized pieces.
Mix together sour cream, mayo, Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp each dried thyme and Poultry seasoning, 1 cup grated Mozzarella, and 1/4 cup Parmesan to make sauce mixture.
Heat 2 tsp. olive oil in large non-stick frying pan and saute mushrooms over medium-high heat until liquid evaporates and mushrooms brown.
Put mushrooms in bottom of casserole dish.
Add 2 tsp. more olive oil and saute onions over medium-high heat until softened and starting to brown.
Put onions over mushrooms in casserole dish.
Heat another 2 tsp. olive oil and add finely-chopped cauliflower.
Cook over medium-high heat, stirring often, until cauliflower softens and barely browns (3-4 minutes, or less for frozen).
Add 1 teaspoon each of dried thyme and Poultry Seasoning and cook 1 minute more.
Season cauliflower rice with salt and black pepper; put in casserole dish over mushrooms and onions.
Put diced turkey in casserole dish over veggies and use plastic spoon to combine ingredients.
Spread sauce mixture over top and gently combine ingredients with sauce until well mixed.
Wipe sides of casserole dish with paper towel if needed.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and bake uncovered until bubbling and top is nicely browned (about 40 minutes).
Let cool about 5 minutes; cut into 8 servings and serve hot.
concerns: Ingredient list states 2 T olive oil divided, but instructions call for 2 tsp. three times (6 tsp. = 2 T); the parenthetical 'more or less depending on your pan' acknowledges this. Transcribed as printed.
Times as stated on the page: prep 45 minutes, cook 40 minutes, total 1 hour 25 minutes. time_active recorded as the stated prep time.
